scope: Map scanner recovery, current-source timing and accuracy evidence

competitor.accessBoundary: Recovered Quick Map route is Premium-only; safely readable local session metadata reported cached plan free. No decryption, license bypass or entitlement bypass was attempted.
competitor.recoveredMethod: Local UI/Python orchestration submits one selected server to a remote scan service, receives streamed partial city/resource results, merges them in process memory and renders ordinary Map rows. The remote scanner-farm AOI algorithm, worker count, freshness and cold-cache state are not exposed by the shipped client.
competitor.timerBoundary: Displayed quick duration starts inside the background quick worker and is not equivalent to button-to-final-paint or durable publication.
competitor.comparisonVerdict: No legitimate matched LwTool live Quick Map timing is available on this machine; no global speed-superiority claim is made.

persistenceBenchmark.scope: Inert SQLite staging only; not a live scan wall-time result.
